# gpu_warp_test's masked-color pointer (DXGI_OUTDUPL_POINTER_SHAPE_TYPE_MASKED_COLOR, README WA33): 16x16, the alpha
# byte is the mask. G: mask 0, opaque green; '.': XOR 0 (transparent); X: XOR FFFFFF (inverts: black, as over white);
# L: XOR 202020 (over white DFDFDF: white).
size 16 16
palette
. FF000000
G 0020C040
X FFFFFFFF
L FF202020
